description: Searches the MORVS Federal Files Register of federal Privacy Act systems of records by system name, number or ID, with agency, recipient, record-category, status and exemption filters. Recipient tags or groups and record flags are pattern matches on the agency text and count at least those matches; recipient matches exclude standard agency boilerplate. DHS matches do not imply ICE; ICE has its own tag. A routine use is the agency statement that it MAY disclose records for a purpose; it does not show that a disclosure happened. An exemption claim may limit access or correction but does not decide a request. Missing systems are not proof no records are kept. Results default to active systems and include published source context.

agency.description: Agency code from the register index. DHS is a separate tag from ICE and does not imply ICE.

changed.description: Filter systems linked to changes after the compilation; their last full published text may be out of date.

exempt.description: Filter systems that claim an exemption; a claim limits access but does not decide an individual request.

flag.description: Record flag from the index. Flags are text matches, reported as at least.

limit.description: Maximum matching systems returned; default 20, allowed 1-50.

query.description: System name or number substring, at most 100 characters. A missing system does not prove no records are kept.

recipient.description: Recipient tag or group from the index. Tags are text matches, reported as at least; a routine use says MAY disclose, not that it did.

status.description: Published system status; defaults to active. Use all for every status, or select one other published status.

name: federal_file_search
title: Search Federal File Systems
